headline: From git push to live URL in 12 seconds
subheadline: Three steps, no YAML — we figured that part out so you don't have to.

steps.title: Connect your repo
steps.description: GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket — pick one, OAuth in. We read your build config and propose sensible defaults.

steps.title: Add your env vars
steps.description: Paste a .env file or sync from your secrets manager. We encrypt at rest and only inject into the right environments.

steps.title: Push to main
steps.description: First deploy lands at your-project.fornix.app. Custom domain when you're ready — TLS auto-issued in under 30 seconds.
